meta.name: deck-course-module
meta.description: 暖纸背景 + Playfair, 左侧学习目标常驻, 含 MCQ 自测页

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建带自测页的课程幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要设计带学习目标和自测的课程模块
copy.tagline_en: Create course slides with self-assessment pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design course modules with learning objectives and quizzes

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会生成一个教学幻灯片模板：包含封面、左侧常驻的学习目标列表、正文页（概念+例子）、多选题自测页以及总结与下一模块预告。整体采用暖纸背景和 Playfair 衬线字体。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作课程、培训或教学幻灯片时触发，适合教育场景。

say.text: 帮我做一门「Python 入门」的课程幻灯片。
给这个培训模块加一道多选题自测。
say.note: Claude 会在当前幻灯片中插入 MCQ 自测页。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will generate a teaching slide template: cover, left-side learning objectives, content pages (concept + example), MCQ self-test page, and wrap-up with next module preview. Uses warm paper background and Playfair serif font.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests course, training, or educational slides. Suitable for education scenarios.

say_en.text: Create a course slide deck for 'Python Introduction'.
Add a multiple-choice self-test to this training module.
say_en.note: Claude will insert an MCQ page into the current slide deck.
